headline: Angola Council of Ministers Reviews $40.9 Billion 2027 Budget Bill
summary: Angola's Council of Ministers reviewed a $40.9 billion budget bill for 2027 ahead of its submission to Parliament.
why: National budget proposals outline government spending priorities, revenue assumptions, and fiscal deficit targets for emerging economies.
